mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150k signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals increased economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below $19.5 trillion signals decreased economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 19500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% and decline in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 285 signals a monetary policy-driven decrease in inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above $670 billion signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 670000, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.
